title: Messages between threads
description:
Send work results from producers to one consumer with a channel.

```
worker 2 found 8 primes up to 20
worker 0 found 4 primes up to 10
worker 1 found 6 primes up to 15
total messages: 3
```
hints: `for (id, limit) in [10, 15, 20].into_iter().enumerate() { let tx = tx.clone(); thread::spawn(move || tx.send((id, limit, count_primes(limit))).unwrap()); }` (lesson 6.01).
`drop(tx);` before `for msg in rx`: the loop ends when every sender is gone.
requirements: Three workers each count primes up to a different limit and send `(id, limit, count)` through `mpsc::channel`.
Each worker gets a clone of the sender; drop the original so the receiving loop ends.
The order of the lines can change between runs.
stretch: Send progress messages as an enum (`Started`, `Done(u32)`) and print both kinds.
